candidate_exposure: Only declared file/API names and hashes received; no product or author tests read.

cases.expectation: Same visible labels with distinct saved IDs remain separate source occurrences. Completed/blocked records remain visible in their original order; selecting either refuses. Eligible selected IDs alone reach the original native calendar serializer.

For authored UTF8 names with punctuation/newlines and distinct dates, selected ICS bytes equal the unchanged accepted model on exactly the same complete backup bytes, IDs and fixed UTC timestamp. Preserve native UID/escaping/ordering/alarm behavior. Record actual process timezone; do not infer cross-timezone parity.

Two independently admitted documents with identical filename/content still have distinct lifetime identity. A review from one cannot download with the other, nor with a JSON-cloned/forged document/review. Harmless raw whitespace changes must retain parsed behavior while binding the actual different byte count/hash.

If hash completion is delayed and caller mutates the original Uint8Array meanwhile, admission must use one consistent captured byte snapshot or refuse. Never combine a digest for one byte sequence with decoded rows from another.

Mutating caller-owned selected-ID arrays or returned download bytes cannot alter retained selected source or later bytes. A first download mutation must not corrupt a second download from the still-current authentic review.

Explicit review retirement makes the previous review unusable even when IDs return A→B→A. Retiring a document prevents new previews and old downloads; another valid document remains usable. Malformed or invalid complete backup never leaks partial admitted rows.

Source-review only: each file-read/hash continuation requires current generation; file/checkbox/Clear/page retirement invalidate the current review before asynchronous work; chooser cancellation retains current document without starting new work. Refusal may show prior admitted metadata truthfully but must not leave old download enabled. No restore/storage/network/import action.

not_claimed: No independent UI/browser execution unless a separate consequential source finding justifies it.
